name: 44440 · Mineral Ridge, OH
findings: ZIP 44440 (Mineral Ridge) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44440 (Mineral Ridge) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44440 (Mineral Ridge) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).
